scripts.shop:check-js: node --check shop/prototype.js && node --check dist/shop/prototype.js && node --check scripts/worker-shop.mjs
scripts.shop:check: npm run shop:check-js && npm run shop:audit && npm run shop:smoke
scripts.shop:deploy-api: set -a; source .env.cloudflare.local; set +a; CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY="$CLOUDFLARE_GLOBAL_API_KEY" npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.shop.toml --env staging
scripts.site:deploy: set -a; source .env.cloudflare.local; set +a; CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY="$CLOUDFLARE_GLOBAL_API_KEY" npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.site.toml
scripts.site:deploy:demo: if test -f .env.cloudflare.local; then set -a; source .env.cloudflare.local; set +a; fi; if test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_GLOBAL_API_KEY"; then export CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY="$CLOUDFLARE_GLOBAL_API_KEY"; fi; npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.toml
